title: Freeze and decode recovery slot manifests v1 and v2
description: Independent P1.5 prerequisite. Extract recovery-slot manifest authority into a strict version-dispatched codec. Freeze the genuine pre-2364d4e `/1` shape from Git as an immutable fixture, define `/2` as the only digest-bound writer shape, and make malformed declared versions fail without reinterpretation. The parent later wires this codec into slot verification and mixed-slot selection.
definitionOfDone: A committed fixture reproduces the exact historical moe-recovery-slot/1 key set from 2364d4e^ and decodes without databaseDigest while retaining generation, incarnation, key-epoch, payload-digest, exact-key, and bounded-value checks.
Encoding always emits exact moe-recovery-slot/2 with a required lowercase 64-hex databaseDigest and never emits /1.

Strict declared-version dispatch rejects unknown versions, /1 with databaseDigest or any extra/missing key, and /2 with missing/empty/nonhex/uppercase/wrong-length databaseDigest; no /2 failure is retried as /1.
Valid v1/v2 results and payload digest maps are recursively frozen; hostile JSON/proxy/oversized bytes refuse without throwing or exposing stored contents.
Focused store tests run standalone with nonzero counts and mutation of the version branch or databaseDigest validation makes named assertions red.
taskRails: Do not edit recovery-anchor-contracts.ts, recovery-anchor-install.ts, recovery-anchor tests, schema, or SQLite in this slice.
The v1 fixture is append-only historical evidence; never rewrite it into /2 or add databaseDigest.
Do not treat current digest-bearing `/1` bytes as genuine legacy; exact key sets and declared versions are authoritative.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Rejected teaching recovery-anchor-install.ts both shapes inline because it is already 293 lines and would mix codec admission with file verification. Rejected accepting current digest-bearing `/1` as legacy because the same declared version would then name two incompatible schemas. Rejected migration-by-rewrite because a crash during fixture conversion would add another slot authority transition. Use strict read-only version dispatch: exact historical `/1` remains readable, only `/2` is writable, and the anchor still selects the slot.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: Git at 2364d4e^ proves historical `/1` was emitted by JSON.stringify over exactly generationDigest, incarnationRef, keyEpochRef, payloadDigests, slotManifestVersion, with no databaseDigest. Current code added databaseDigest first but left RECOVERY_ANCHOR_SLOT_MANIFEST_VERSION at `/1`. Slot payload digests are SHA-256 from recovery-anchor-fs.digestBytes; generation/incarnation/key-epoch originated as nonempty request identifiers. The parent will map any decode refusal to RECOVERY_ANCHOR_PERSISTENCE_UNPROVEN and compare a valid `/2` databaseDigest to on-disk bytes as RECOVERY_ANCHOR_SLOT_UNVERIFIABLE.
planningNotes.risks: Historical compatibility requires preserving the exact `/1` key set and JSON.stringify byte form, including no databaseDigest. Standard JSON.parse silently accepts duplicate keys; require a canonical round-trip equal to the original UTF-8 bytes so whitespace, reordering, duplicates, and overwritten members cannot become equivalent authority. Bound bytes before decode, reject invalid UTF-8, validate safe forward-slash relative payload paths and lowercase SHA-256 payload values, and recursively freeze maps/manifests/results. Do not import the live recovery-anchor-contracts slot constant because it is the buggy `/1` authority this child replaces.
